faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions.
faq.q1: What types of furniture do you make?
faq.a1: We offer living room, bedroom, office, kitchen and dining room furniture, plus doors, wall art, materials, and full interior design.
faq.q2: How long does an order take?
faq.a2: It depends on product type and quantity. Contact us for detailed lead times.
faq.q3: Do you deliver to my location?
faq.a3: Yes — we deliver to Addis Ababa and surrounding areas.
faq.a4: Yes. We design and build custom pieces tailored to each client.
faq.q5: Do your products come with a warranty?
faq.a5: Yes — all our products come with a warranty. Contact us for details.
